excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a paleontologist, braided black hair, African ethnicity. Wears a light white tee shirt worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, khaki shorts and brown hiking boots.
excavation_context.stage: Scraping Brittle Mudstone Beds on a Sunny Ridge

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_6 uses a pointed hand trowel to carefully scrape flaking layers of variegated red-purple mudstone on a sun-drenched, high-relief outcrop. The scraping exposes the distinctive bladed nasal horn and sharp teeth of a Ceratosaurus skull. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
